blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.
blocks.zh: 为什么取消参考政策 KL 正规化有时会改善群体政策的优化? 这促使人们研究参考政策信息应如何输入与群体相关的最新情况。 我们分析KL和奖励之间的相互作用中的七个潜在失败模式:奖励剪辑后的剩余KL更新,梯度取消后的更新,以及同等奖励的组别;响应长度的KL增长和相对贡献的不平衡;KL集中在少量的符号上;以及当k1被纳入奖励时的取样噪音. 我们提出零分校准政策优化(ZCPO),它使用条件KL测量的相对漂移来校准组内奖励系数,并将其纳入基数代位. 数学推理实验和模拟支持这种设计在我们环境中的有效性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Group-relative policy optimization trains language models by comparing rewards within a group, eliminating the need for a value model ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Recent methods improve training through clipping, normalization, and gradient aggregation; among them, DAPO and GMPO omit an explicit reference KL penalty ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . In controlled experiments, PAPO removes the reference KL from GRPO, increasing the overall average multimodal reasoning accuracy (avg@8) of Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 7B from 47.92 % 47.92\% to 50.18 % 50.18\% and from 58.78 % 58.78\% to 61.30 % 61.30\% , respectively ( Wang et al., 2026b , Appendix F, Table 4) . Text reasoning ablations in Open-Reasoner-Zero also report that PPO without KL outperforms variants that add KL to the loss or reward under their evaluation settings ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 集团关系政策优化通过比较集团内部的奖励来培训语言模型,消除了对价值模型的需求(Shao等人,2024年). 最近的方法通过剪报、正常化和梯度汇总改进了培训;其中,DAPO和GMPO省略了明确参考KL惩罚(Yu等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年)。 在有控制的实验中,PAPO从GRPO中删除了参考KL,将Qun2.5-VL-3B和7B的总体平均多式联运推理精度(avg@8)分别从47.92 % 47.92%提高到50.18% 50.18%和58.78% 58.78%提高到61.30% 61.30%(Wang等人,2026b,附录F,表4)。 Open-Reasoner-Zero的文字推理模拟也报告说,没有KL的PPO的变体比在评价设置下将KL加入损失或奖励的变体要多(Hu等人,2025年).

blocks.en: The observation that removing reference KL can help training raises a broader design question: how should reference-policy information enter group-relative optimization? We analyze the interaction between independent KL and reward updates, and study within-group relative calibration using reference-policy drift. Specifically, our contributions are as follows: • We consolidate seven potential failure modes of KL in GRPO and its variants. These modes characterize residual regularization after reward gradients vanish, KL imbalances across lengths and positions, and sampling noise in KL estimation. • We propose ZCPO, which uses conditional KL to calibrate group-relative reward coefficients, and characterize coefficient optimality for fixed inputs; mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design’s effectiveness in our settings.
blocks.zh: 关于删除参考文献KL有助于培训的意见提出了一个更广泛的设计问题:参考政策信息应如何进入集团关系优化? 我们分析独立的KL和奖励更新之间的相互作用,并利用参考政策漂移来研究组内相对校准. 具体来说,我们的贡献如下: 我们合并了GRPO及其变体中KL的7种潜在故障模式. 这些模式在奖励梯度消失、KL在长度和位置上的不平衡以及KL估算中的取样噪音后,具有剩余正规化的特点。 我们提议使用有条件的 KL 来校准群体相对的奖励系数, 并描述固定输入的系数优化性; 数学推理实验和缩写支持这个设计在我们环境中的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Variants of group-relative policy optimization. With a fixed reference, GRPO adds a per-token k3 KL penalty relative to the reference model to the loss ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent work primarily modifies clipping, normalization, and aggregation: DAPO introduces clip-higher, dynamic sampling, and token-level aggregation ( Yu et al., 2025 ) ; GSPO uses sequence-level importance ratios ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; GMPO uses geometric-mean aggregation ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; and a range of methods improve clipping or trust regions ( Xi et al., 2026 ; Petrenko et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . These studies improve group policy optimization from different perspectives; our focus is the interaction between the KL term and group-relative reward updates and the points at which it may fail. Adaptive AGPO uses statistics such as KL drift to adjust clipping and sampling temperature ( Hu et al., 2026 ) ; asymmetric AGPO constrains group-relative advantages and strengthens negative updates for incorrect responses ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . For groups with limited information, existing methods recover learning signals through sampling allocation, trajectory filtering, or finer-grained rewards ( Sudalairaj et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . Bae et al. (2026) retain training prompts with intermediate success rates through online difficulty filtering. GOPO replaces explicit KL regularization with a quadratic probability-ratio penalty ( Zixian, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 集团关系政策优化的备选方案. GRPO在固定的参考文献中,相对于损失的参考模型(Shao等人,2024年),增加了每吨K3KL的罚款。 随后的工作主要是修改剪辑、正常化和汇总:DAPO引入了剪辑较高、动态采样和符号级汇总(Yu等人,2025年);普惠制O采用序列级重要比率(Zheng等人,2025年);GMPO采用几何-平均值汇总(Zhao等人,2026年);一系列方法改进剪辑或信任区域(Xi等人,2026年;Petrenko等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a年;Cai等人,2026年)。 这些研究从不同的角度改进了团体政策优化;我们的重点是KL术语和团体相对奖励更新之间的相互作用以及它可能失败的点. 适应性的AGPO使用KL漂移等统计数据来调整剪切温度和采样温度(Hu等人,2026年);不对称的AGPO约束了群体相对优势,加强了对不正确反应的负面更新(徐等人,2026年). 对于信息有限的群体,现有方法通过抽样分配、轨迹过滤或更细的奖励来恢复学习信号(Sudalairaj等人,2026年;Lin等人,2025年;Deng等人,2026年)。 Bae等人(2026年)通过在线难度过滤,保留了中等成功率的培训提示。 GOPO将明确的KL规范化替换为四极概率-比例处罚(Zixian, 2026).

blocks.en: KL estimators and placement. Vojnovic & Yun (2025) analyze how reward normalization and reference-policy penalties jointly determine GRPO’s stationary policy. Tang & Munos (2025) analyze bias in KL gradient estimation and discuss leave-one-out baselines and causal accumulation, but focus primarily on recovering the gradient of a given KL objective rather than the interaction of independent KL with reward clipping or group filtering. Shah et al. (2026) compare the gradient bias of k1/k3 in rewards or losses under current-policy sampling and evaluate performance in asynchronous training, but do not discuss constructing conditional KL as a within-group zero-sum correction coefficient. The online algorithms of GVPO and RPG use an old policy that is updated throughout training as the reference ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) ; from the perspective of F6 in this paper, this may alleviate the persistent constraint that a fixed initial reference imposes on policy changes already learned. However, for constructions based on sampled log-ratios, refreshing the reference does not guarantee the elimination of subsequent conditional sampling fluctuations, nor does within-group centering guarantee their elimination.
blocks.zh: KL 估计和安置. Vojnovic & Yun (2025) 分析奖励正常化和参考政策处罚如何共同决定GRPO的固定政策。 Tang & Munos (2025) 分析 KL 梯度估计中的偏差,并讨论留一出基线和因果积累,但主要侧重于恢复给定 KL 目标的梯度,而不是独立 KL 与奖励剪辑或组过滤的相互作用. Shah等人(2026年)比较了当前政策采样下 k1/k3 奖励或损失的梯度偏差,并在同步训练中评价性能,但不讨论构建有条件的KL作为组内零和校正系数. GVPO和RPG的在线算法将整个培训过程中更新的旧政策作为参考(Zhang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年);从本文中F6的角度来看,这可以缓解固定初始参考对已经学到的政策变化造成的持续制约. 然而,对于基于采样对数的构造,刷新参考并不能保证消除随后的有条件采样波动,组内中心也不能保证消除.

blocks.en: Conditional KL and local constraint adjustment. Amini et al. (2025) use per-prefix conditional KL to reduce the variance of numerical estimation and full-sequence KL gradient estimation, but do not study a joint coefficient design combining length normalization, within-group centering, and gating on reward-active groups. Vassoyan et al. (2025) weight per-token KL by the reference policy’s entropy to relax constraints at highly uncertain positions, but this confidence-based rule does not address cases in which the reference policy is overconfident.
blocks.zh: 有条件的KL和地方约束调整. Amini等人(2025年)使用每个前缀的有条件KL来减少数值估计和全序KL梯度估计的差异,但不研究将长度正常化,组内中心化,和对奖励活性组群的加成相结合的联合系数设计. Vassoyan 等人(2025年)通过参考政策的Entropty来放松高度不确定位置的限制,而这种基于信任的规则并没有处理参考政策的过度自信的情况。

blocks.en: 3 Seven Potential Failure Modes in the Interaction Between KL and Rewards in GRPO and Its Variants
blocks.zh: GRPO中KL与奖励之间的相互作用中的7种潜在失败模式及其变式

blocks.en: This section characterizes differences in how KL signals and group-relative reward updates act under specified conditions, and uses these differences to formulate mechanistic hypotheses about their effects on training. We first analyze the case where per-token KL is added as an independent loss term, then discuss variants that incorporate the k1 sampled log-ratio into rewards in F7; the conditions for each mode are stated separately. GRPO uses an independent KL loss ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . The subsequent experiments report structural diagnostics, F1 mechanism controls, and the task performance of the full method. Appendix E reports the F3 group-gating ablation.

blocks.en: The experiments show that a small fraction of tokens accounts for most of the KL signal (Figure 3 (e)). Under an independent KL constraint with a fixed reference policy, these positions can continue to experience a local pullback if they reappear in subsequent training and their probabilities still deviate from the reference policy. If this effect conflicts with the direction of reward optimization, it may restrict the corresponding policy changes.

blocks.en: Through within-group centering, ZCPO removes the component of length-normalized KL shared across responses. In our setting, ZCPO exhibits greater drift at the initial token than vanilla, with a magnitude comparable to pure DAPO (Figure 3 (f)). At step 20, the covariance contribution of the first 10 tokens to the variance of K K is approximately 4%, indicating that the initial segment does not dominate the variance of the relative KL coefficient at this step. These results support ZCPO’s mitigation of drift suppression at initial positions.
blocks.zh: 通过组内中心化,ZCPO去除各个响应共享的长度常态KL的组件. 在我们的环境下,ZCPO在最初显示的漂移比香草要大,其规模与纯DAPO相当(图3(f))。 在步骤20中,前10个令牌对K K差异的共性贡献约为4%,表明初始段在此步骤中并不支配相对KL系数的差异. 这些结果有助于ZCPO减轻最初位置的漂移抑制。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We study how reference-policy information can enter group-relative optimization, analyze seven potential failure modes in KL–reward interactions, and propose ZCPO to calibrate within-group zero-sum coefficients using relative drift measured by conditional KL. Mathematical reasoning experiments with Qwen2.5-32B and long-context experiments with Qwen3-4B support this design’s effectiveness in our settings; the long-context ablations further evaluate the role of group gating. Our current evaluation covers multiple model scales and tasks; cross-model evidence for model families beyond Qwen is provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 我们研究参考政策信息如何进入集团相对优化,分析KL-奖励相互作用中的七个潜在失败模式,并提议ZCPO利用条件KL测量的相对漂移量校准集团内部零和系数. 与Quen2.5-32B的数学推理实验和与Quen3-4B的长文本实验支持了这种设计在我们环境中的有效性;长文本的拼音进一步评价了组格的作用. 我们目前的评价涉及多个模型尺度和任务;附录F提供了昆文以外模范家庭的跨模型证据。

blocks.en:
Compared with standard KL, ZCPO uses fused computation to reuse the forward-pass outputs and logits of the current and reference policies, avoiding duplicate full-model forward passes and additional memory for logits. The added arithmetic consists primarily of per-token reductions over the full vocabulary, with essentially negligible additional runtime.
When the conditional distributions of the current and reference policies are close, the exact conditional KL is a second-order quantity in the distribution perturbation and is susceptible to rounding errors in bf16 logits. To ensure numerical accuracy during bf16 training, we recompute the output-layer projection in fp32 and perform the KL reduction over the full vocabulary in fp32; together, this projection recomputation and KL reduction increase total GPU compute time by approximately 0.5 % 0.5\% relative to standard KL under the same configuration.
blocks.zh:
与标准KL相比,ZCPO使用离线计算重新使用当前和参考政策的前传输出和日志,避免重复全模前传通行证和日志的额外内存. 增加的算术主要包括按音节计算,比整个词汇减少,额外时间几乎微不足道。
当当前和参考政策的有条件分布接近时,精确的有条件的KL是分布扰动中的第二顺序数量,在bf16对数中容易发生四舍五入错误. 为了保证bf16训练期间的数值准确性,我们重新计算fp32中的输出层投影,并在fp32中完成全词汇的KL还原;加在一起,这种投影重算和KL还原使GPU总的计算时间相对于同一配置下的标准KL增加了约0.5% 0.5%.

blocks.en: Appendix C Diagnostics of the KL Gradient Share
blocks.zh: 附录C KL 梯度股份的诊断

blocks.en: The gradient share is measured on the first mini-batch of each step, when the parameters have not yet been updated in that step, the current policy equals the sampling policy, and every reward gradient gate is open. On the same mini-batch and with the same parameters, two separate full forward–backward passes are run: one with the reward-branch loss only and one with the KL-branch loss only (the k3 term for vanilla, the KL term of the coefficient for ZCPO); the norms of the two parameter gradients and their inner product are read out, and the total gradient norm is composed from them. The share is the ratio of the KL-branch gradient norm to the total gradient norm. Norms are computed over the full parameter vector. These two extra backward passes are used only for recording and do not contribute to the parameter update.
blocks.zh: 梯度份额按每一步的第一个小批量衡量,当该步骤中参数尚未更新时,当前政策等于采样政策,每个奖励梯度门都打开. 在同一个小批次上,并使用相同的参数,运行了两个独立的完全前向后向的传球:一个只使用奖赏-处损失,一个只使用KL-处损失(香草的k3术语,ZCPO系数的KL术语);两个参数梯度及其内产值的规范被读出,总梯度规范由它们组成. 该份额是KL-分支梯度规范与总梯度规范的比例. 标准是按整个参数矢量计算的。 这两张额外的后退通行证仅用于录制,并不有助于参数更新.

blocks.en: The absolute gradient norms of the two branches show that, within a method, the reward-branch norm stays essentially unchanged across β \beta while the KL-branch norm grows approximately linearly with β \beta , so changes in the share come from the numerator rather than the denominator. blocks.en: An independent KL term against a fixed reference penalizes policy deviation without evaluating its task benefit, so a beneficial change that increases KL also incurs a regularization cost. ZCPO removes the direct coefficient penalty from the shared component b q b_{q} ; this algebraic property does not distinguish whether a shared change is beneficial. Both approaches retain reward-driven updates. Because different prompts share policy parameters, the absence of reward comparisons in the current group does not imply an absence of reward feedback throughout training: when the reward captures a behavior’s effects and other prompts or later rollouts provide informative alternatives, corresponding reward comparisons may still arise. This describes a possible source of learning signals, not an established effect of correction across groups. If a change leaves the reward unchanged across the relevant training distribution and its effect on KL is entirely shared within each group, the reward provides no direct signal to distinguish that change, and the common KL component removed by centering provides no direct pull toward the reference policy.

blocks.en: Appendix I Evidence Scope and Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录一 证据的范围和讨论

blocks.en: We study the use of reference-policy information at three levels: update structure, coefficient construction, and task performance. The theoretical analysis characterizes the interaction between KL and reward updates under specified conditions and gives the optimal zero-sum coefficient calibration for fixed inputs. The F1 mechanism controls and F3 group-gating ablation evaluate the roles of KL updates at clipped positions and gating groups with identical rewards, respectively, in their corresponding settings. Other gradient, length, and drift diagnostics characterize training behavior and motivate testable mechanistic hypotheses about its effects on optimization. Mathematical reasoning, long-context, and cross-model experiments jointly support ZCPO’s task performance in the evaluated configurations. These cross-setting results assess the effectiveness of the full method, while the scope and contribution of individual mechanisms to task gains are discussed separately through analyses and controls under their respective conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们研究参考政策信息在三个层面的使用:更新结构、系数构建和任务绩效。 理论分析定性了KL和奖励更新在特定条件下的相互作用,给出了固定输入的最佳零和系数校准. F1机制控制器和F3群调减值器分别在剪接位置和相同奖励的群调中评价KL更新在相应场合的作用. 其他梯度,长度,和漂移性诊断对训练行为具有特征,并激发了对其对优化效果的可测试的机械假设. 数学推理,长文,跨模型实验共同支持ZCPO在评价配置中的任务表现. 这些交叉制定的结果评估了整个方法的有效性,而个别机制对任务成果的范围和贡献则通过在各自条件下的分析和控制单独讨论。
